sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised proposal and your continued flexibility. It is always a pleasure working with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we are keen to keep supporting your production with our extensive range and reliable service.

Please note that extending the payment terms to 90 days and reducing the contract duration to 24 months increases our financing and planning costs. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. However, we can accommodate these requested terms at a price of €5.30 per unit. 

To summarize our current Angebot, we offer a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

decisions.tactician: Every option sits at roughly -20 % to the supplier, so the real choice is which terms best meet its needs at the lowest C for us. Among the non-12-month options, o5 and o6 tie for the lowest C (€232,559). o6 adds a 36-month commitment, which serves its strong need for volume and its moderate need for planning security at no cost to us. That makes a long anchor more acceptable than E0's 60 d terms, which carry a higher C. A clause option would cost us €2–4k and the 12-month options cost far more. The recent index declines and our rising forecast support the low anchor without leaking any urgency.

decisions.tactician: E0 keeps its own structure: the AS-14404 clause it asked for, 36 months and 45 days. It differs from its standing sheet offer:70740-1 only in price, which makes agreement easy to grant and fits its strongest stated needs. The no-clause options o2 to o6 have a slightly lower C, but they drop the condition it made explicit and would likely bring back a clause demand. o1 and o3 also cut the term to 24 months, giving up the binding volume it values most. Taking a standing sheet now would forgo about €22k of the C reduction on offer, since its pace suggests one more reply could reach this level. The on-time delivery record of eighty-one percent supports a lower price. Its order-history counter-evidence (earlier orders at €6.10) means we should not cite a2.
